name: Payload To Map Converter
helpText: Uses Ikasan PayloadToMapConverter to convert an FTP/SFTP file-transfer Payload into a Map<String, Object>. The map contains content as text, id, and all payload attributes. Content is decoded using the runtime JVM default charset; this converter has no charset setting. Attributes named content or id override those entries. Use a custom converter when you need explicit character decoding, binary content or different field mappings.

componentName.helpText: The component name displayed on the canvas. It must be unique within the flow.
